acs.text_first_line: AC1 Proof of delivery recorded moves the case into the notice period
AC2 An expired proof window marks the notice unserved
AC3 The notice row and the proof stay with rwb-comms
AC4 A repeated delivery answer changes nothing
AC5 No rule package version in force is a refusal
AC6 An unrecorded decision stops the move
AC7 The case read is refused without the right or outside the scope
AC8 The notice state and the notice-period end show on the two screens
